detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Thymogen

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C14H24N6O9
  • Molecular Weight: 404.38 g/mol
  • Sequence: Glu-Trp (L-glutamyl-tryptophan dipeptide)
  • Structure Class: Synthetic dipeptide (L-glutamyl-L-tryptophan)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Thymogen is a synthetic dipeptide composed of L-glutamic acid and L-tryptophan. It was originally modeled on peptide fragments derived from thymic proteins. In laboratory environments, Thymogen is utilized in research involving peptide signaling and structure-function analysis under controlled experimental conditions. It is provided in lyophilized powder form to ensure stability and high purity during storage.

Research Applications:

Thymogen is utilized in controlled research protocols addressing topics such as:

  • Investigation of peptide-mediated signaling pathways in in vitro systems
  • Study of cellular interaction dynamics and differentiation processes under controlled conditions
  • Analysis of peptide-associated biological responses in laboratory models
  • Comparative evaluation of thymic peptide analogues in defined experimental systems
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized material at −20°C (−4°F)
  • After reconstitution, store at 2–8°C (36–46°F) and use promptly
  • Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling procedures
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Thymogen is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
